address: 3F, Shangri-La The Fort Hotel, 30th Street corner 5th Avenue, Bonifacio Global City, Taguig - Metro Manila, 1634, The Philippines
bio: Canton Road, one of Manila's premier Chinese restaurants, delivers an elegant Cantonese dining experience under the guidance of chef Wang Wei. The menu blends tradition and innovation, with refined takes on classic dishes. Expect signature roasted and barbecued meats alongside seafood-laden fried rice. Meticulous presentation, polished service and a strong commitment to heritage make this a standout for both familiar favourites and fresh discoveries.
